grades.label: Academic Continuance Policy
grades.text: In order to remain a major, all students are required to maintain a cumulative GPA in CA courses of 2.67.

grades.label: Academic Continuance Policy
grades.text: Process: All SCA student GPA levels will be evaluated at the end of each academic year, normally at the end of the Spring semester.

grades.label: Academic Continuance Policy
grades.text: A student who falls below the required cumulative GPA in CA courses of 2.67 will be notified of their probation status as a major with a limited time to adjust their CA GPA.

grades.label: Academic Continuance Policy
grades.text: If the student does not bring the cumulative GPA in CA courses to 2.67 in the allotted time, he/she will be dropped from the major.

grades.label: Academic Continuance Policy
grades.text: If the student is in first or second year of study within the major and falls below the required cumulative GPA in CA courses of 2.67, the student will have two semesters to bring up their average to 2.67.

caveats: Converted automatically from the calendar; confirm with an advisor.
